entries.name: Human
entries.description: The registered living of the Warrens, quick to adapt beneath unfamiliar stones (+25% XP).

entries.name: Revenant
entries.description: Catalogued dead who refused the final entry. Slow to mend (50% healing). Resists Cold (+50%) and Void (+25%), vulnerable to Radiant (-25%).

entries.name: Cambion
entries.description: Born of a contract signed beneath the Geometry. Resists Fire (+50%) and Void (+25%), vulnerable to Cold (-25%).

entries.name: Ash-Marked
entries.description: Scoured in the Sun-House flues until fire answered back. Resists Fire (+50%), vulnerable to Cold (-25%).

entries.name: Veil-Touched
entries.description: Dwellers along the Ophite seams who read hidden joints in the stone (+1 Sight). Resists Void (+35%), vulnerable to Radiant (-10%).

entries.name: Iron-Vowed
entries.description: Forged to carry sealed decrees without flinching (-5 Speed). Resists Physical (+15%) and Cold (+20%).

entries.name: Unrecorded
entries.description: Struck off every census before birth, walking the margins unseen. Resists Void (+25%).

entries.name: Debt-Sworn
entries.description: Carries an open tally in blood and breath across the lower courts. Resists Radiant (+20%).
